prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game UI book icon material sheet for Desktop Wulin
Primary request: Create a white-background material sheet of 60 martial arts manual book icons for the internal-power system (neigong). Use a large canvas with wide outer margins; no icon may touch or approach the image edge.
Composition/framing: strict 10-column by 6-row grid, exactly one closed book or scroll-manual icon per cell, centered, fully visible, no overlap, generous white spacing inside every cell and a clear white border around the entire sheet. Columns left to right are tiers 0-9, progressing from plain beginner manual to legendary divine manual. Rows top to bottom are: xuanjia defensive armor manual, fanzhen reflective force manual, huichun healing spring manual, ningyuan inner-origin energy manual, tiegu iron-bone toughness manual, lingshe spirit-snake evasion manual.
Style/medium: detailed fine pixel art / polished Chinese wuxia RPG item icons, readable at 96x96, crisp silhouette, ornate book covers, no readable text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat pure white background, no shadows, no floor, no gradients.
Color palette: tier columns use white, green, blue, purple, orange, red, gold, cyan, rose, fiery orange progression; internal-power theme uses jade, ink, bronze, pale energy marks.
Motifs: armor scales for xuanjia, mirror/spiral rebound for fanzhen, spring leaf for huichun, glowing qi orb for ningyuan, iron bone/rivet for tiegu, snake curve for lingshe.
Constraints: exactly 60 icons, no labels, no Chinese characters, no numbers, no watermark, no people, no loose particles detached from books, every cell contains one complete book/manual icon, all books fully visible with no cropping at the sheet edges.
